benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: A Free Night Award (redeemable at properties valued at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) granted each year after card renewal.
benefits.terms: Granted automatically each year after the card renewal month. Redeemable at participating hotels at or under a 35,000-point redemption level (plus any required cash co-pay for higher-value stays). Certain hotels charge resort fees not covered by the award.

benefits.name: Additional Free Night Award for Spend
benefits.description: An additional Free Night Award (redeemable at properties valued at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) earned after reaching an annual spend threshold.
benefits.terms: Earned after spending $60,000 in purchases on the card in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on paid stays, late checkout, and room upgrades when available.
benefits.terms: Automatic upon card membership by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status, granted each calendar year.
benefits.terms: 15 Elite Night Credits per calendar year.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen carry-on and checked baggage while traveling on a common carrier.
benefits.terms: Secondary to airline coverage. Carry-on coverage up to $1,250 per person; checked bag coverage up to $500 per person.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, U.S. wireless telephone services purchased directly from service providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
